title: Schwalbe tubeless FAQ
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. Schwalbe says a tubeless set-up needs an airtight tubeless wheel or a tubeless-compatible wheel with tubeless rim tape, a tubeless valve and sealing fluid, and that tubeless conversion is only possible with tubeless-compatible wheels and tires; only wheels approved by the manufacturer for tubeless use should be used. If the rim's maximum pressure is lower than the tire's, the lower rim maximum must not be exceeded. Doc Blue sealant remains active for around 2,000 km or 2-7 months depending on temperature; once the system is airtight, the additional puncture protection exists only while active sealant remains in the tire.
